newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNYARDS IN DIRE STRAITS, SEEKS WAY OUT - PAPER.
newsitem.headline: FINNYARDS IN DIRE STRAITS, SEEKS WAY OUT - PAPER.

text.p: Troubled Finnish shipyard Finnyards may lose a key order from Swedish Stena Rederi for four high-speed passenger ferries and that loss could even sink the shipyard, daily Helsingin Sanomat reported on Friday.
Finnyards said in a statement received on Friday that Stena Rederi would not go on with the order for the moment.

Helsingin Sanomat said Finnyards -- 47.9 percent owned by UPM-Kymmene, 13 percent by the Finnish government and 39.1 percent by Finnish shipping company Hollming -- was now trying to rescue the order.
Finnyards' owners did not comment on the situation. Helsingin Sanomat quoted a senior official at the ministry of trade and industry as saying that the exisiting alternatives were being examined.
Nobody at Finnyards or at UPM-Kymmene was immediately available for comment on Friday.
